raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the original Transformer encoder from "Attention Is All You Need" has 8 layers, whereas it actually has 6 layers. This led to the calculation of a difference of 4 layers instead of the correct difference of 6 layers between BERT-base (12 layers) and the Transformer encoder (6 layers). The Planner did not verify the information systematically by engaging WebSurfer or FileSurfer to confirm the number of layers in the original Transformer architecture. This oversight resulted in an incorrect final answer.
